configurationFields.label: Spawn BTR On Streets
configurationFields.description: If set, the BTR will spawn on streets

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Dynamic Vehicle Exfils
configurationFields.description: If set, vehicle exfils will scale to the number of players in the raid

configurationFields.label: Allow Free Camera
configurationFields.description: If set, players can use the free camera while still alive

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectate Free Camera
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be forced to spectate other players rather than be able to move freely

configurationFields.label: Blacklisted Items
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of item template IDs that cannot be sent

configurationFields.label: Force Save On Death
configurationFields.description: If set, saving will be forced upon death, preventing ALT+F4 cheese

configurationFields.label: Required Mods
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of required mods on the server. If enabled, always include standard SPT mods: com.SPT.custom, com.SPT.singleplayer, com.SPT.core, com.SPT.debugging, com.fika.core, com.bepis.bepinex.configurationmanager

configurationFields.label: Optional Mods
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of mods that are allowed in addition to Required Mods

configurationFields.label: Enable Inertia
configurationFields.description: If set, intertia will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Shared Quest Progression
configurationFields.description: If set, quest progression in raid will be shared

configurationFields.label: Allow Editing Raid Settings
configurationFields.description: If set, clients can modify the raid settings before starting a raid

configurationFields.label: Enable Transits
configurationFields.description: If set, transits will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Anyone Can Start Raid
configurationFields.description: If set, anyone can click 'START RAID'

configurationFields.label: Enable Reviving
configurationFields.description: If set, the reviving mechanic will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Headshots Always Kill
configurationFields.description: If set, headshots will always kill outright instead of downing the player

configurationFields.label: Grenades Always Kill
configurationFields.description: If set, grenade kills will always kill outright instead of downing the player

configurationFields.label: Allow Looting Downed Players
configurationFields.description: If set, downed players can be looted before they bleed out

configurationFields.label: Max Revives
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of revives allowed per player. Set to 0 for infinite revives

configurationFields.label: Revive Bleedout Time
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a downed player has before they bleed out and become unrevivable

configurationFields.label: Revive Time
configurationFields.description: Sets how long it takes to revive a downed player

configurationFields.label: Disable Chat Bots
configurationFields.description: If set, chat bots will not be disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Webhook
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the webhook functionality

configurationFields.label: Webhook Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the webhook

configurationFields.label: Webhook Avatar URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the avatar URL for the webhook

configurationFields.label: Webhook URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for the webhook

configurationFields.label: Enable Item Sending
configurationFields.description: If set, item sending will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Item Sending Storage Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that sent items will be stored before expiring

configurationFields.label: Sent Items Lose FiR Status
configurationFields.description: If set, sent items will lose their FiR status

configurationFields.label: List All Profiles In Launcher
configurationFields.description: If set, the launcher will list all profiles

configurationFields.label: Session Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the server waits for a keepalive ping from a client until the session is considered crashed

configurationFields.label: Enable Dev Profiles
configurationFields.description: If set, dev profiles will be able to be created

configurationFields.label: Enable Non-Standard Profiles
configurationFields.description: If set, non-standard EFT profiles will be able to be created

configurationFields.label: Admin IDs
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of admin IDs

configurationFields.label: Enable NAT Punching
configurationFields.description: If set, the NAT punch server will be enabled

configurationFields.label: NAT Punching Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the NAT punching amount

configurationFields.label: Headless Client Profiles Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of headless profiles to generate automatically, one per [headless client](https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Headless)

configurationFields.label: Generate Scripts For Headless Clients
configurationFields.description: If set, a startup script will be automatically generated for each headless client profile. Required unless you know what you are doing

configurationFields.label: Connection IP For Headless Clients
configurationFields.description: Sets the IP the headless client should connect to. Set to 127.0.0.1 if local

configurationFields.label: Set Headless Client Level To Average Of Lobby
configurationFields.description: If set, the level of headless clients will be set to the average level of the lobby

configurationFields.label: Restart Headless Clients After Amount Of Raids
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of raids after which the headless client will restart. Set to 0 to disable

configurationFields.label: Enable Launcher Background
configurationFields.description: If set, the launcher background will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Dotnet Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [ASP.NET Core Runtime/.NET Runtime 9.0 version](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/9.0) to install. Empty = latest. Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: ASP.NET Core Runtime Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{DOTNETVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path '{SERVER_DIR}/'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/9.0/releases.json).\"latest-runtime\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: 7-Zip Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

deploymentSteps.name: SPT Directory Backup
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/server'; if (Test-Path 'SPT.bak') { Remove-Item 'SPT.bak' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'SPT') { Copy-Item -Path 'SPT' -Destination 'SPT.bak' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

deploymentSteps.name: SPT Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'tarkov/server'; $DownloadURL = 'https://github.com/sp-tarkov/build/releases/download/4.0.13/SPT-4.0.13-40087-2891fd4.7z'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"$DownloadURL\" -OutFile 'SPT.7z'; & ../7-Zip/7z.exe x -y -aoa SPT.7z | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'SPT.7z' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"
